questions.text:
Goods and Services Tax (GST) is an indirect tax introduced in India in 2017 that is imposed on the supply of goods and services, and it subsumes all indirect taxes except few. It is a destination-based tax imposed on goods and services used, and it is not imposed at the point of origin from where goods come. GST also has a few components specific to state governments, central government and Union Territories (UTs).

Which one of the following statements can be inferred from the given passage?
questions.solution:
GST is a destination-based tax on goods and services used, not imposed at the point of origin. So it is imposed at the point of usage.

It does not include all indirect taxes ("except few") and it has a UT component, so the other options contradict the passage.

Answer: GST is imposed at the point of usage of goods and services

questions.text: The figure below shows an annular ring with outer and inner as b and a, respectively. The annular space has been painted in the form of blue colour circles touching the outer and inner periphery of annular space. If maximum n number of circles can be painted, then the unpainted area available in annular space is _____.
questions.solution:
Each circle touches both rings, so its diameter = b [latex]-[/latex] a and its area = [latex]\pi\frac{(b-a)^2}{4}[/latex].

Unpainted area = ring area [latex]-[/latex] n circles = [latex]\pi(b^2-a^2)-n\pi\frac{(b-a)^2}{4}=\pi\left[(b^2-a^2)-\frac n4(b-a)^2\right][/latex]

Answer: Option 1

questions.text: Two straight lines are drawn perpendicular to each other in X-Y plane. If [latex]\alpha[/latex] and [latex]\beta[/latex] are the acute angles the straight lines make with the X-axis, then [latex]\alpha +\beta[/latex] is ________.
questions.solution:
If one line makes acute angle [latex]\alpha[/latex] with the X-axis, a perpendicular line makes [latex]90^\circ+\alpha[/latex], i.e. an acute angle of [latex]90^\circ-\alpha[/latex] with the axis.

[latex]\alpha+\beta=\alpha+(90^\circ-\alpha)=90^\circ[/latex]

Answer: [latex]90^\circ[/latex]

questions.text: The total revenue of a company during 2014 - 2018 is shown in the bar graph. If the total expenditure of the company in each year is 500 million rupees, then the aggregate profit or loss (in percentage) on the total expenditure of the company during 2014 - 2018 is ___________.
questions.solution:
Total revenue = 500 + 700 + 800 + 600 + 400 = 3000 million.
Total expenditure = 5 [latex]\times[/latex] 500 = 2500 million.

Profit = 500 million = 500/2500 [latex]\times[/latex] 100 = 20% of expenditure.

Answer: 20% profit
